A B Concession - Winding up petitions against respondent­ company - Concession by counsel of the respondents to c pay the due debts in 10 and 8 equal instalments respectively - Company Judge disposed of the petition in view of the concession - Order of Company Judge challenged upto Supreme directed the respondent to move the Company Judge for modification of its order - D Company Judge refused the modification - Division Bench of High Court by impugned order held that the counsel made the concession by mistake and set aside the order of Company Judge - On appeal, held: Order of
